chunks: And from him, from al-Nadr, from Yahya al-Halabi, from Ayub ibn al-Hurr, from Abu Basir, who said:

I was with Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), and he called for al-Jami'ah (the collection), looked into it, and found: 'A woman died and left her husband, with no heir for her except him; the wealth is all his.'

key_terms.الْجَامِعَةِ: al-Jami'ah, a specific collection of hadiths or legal rulings attributed to the Imams

ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance share of a husband when his wife dies with no other heirs?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies the application of the 'al-ghalabah' (dominance) principle in Shia jurisprudence, where the husband inherits the entire estate when no other heirs with fixed shares or residuary rights exist. It highlights the scholarly consensus that in the absence of children, parents, or siblings, the husband's share expands from one-quarter or one-half to the full remainder, reflecting the comprehensive nature of al-Jami'ah as a foundational legal text.
